description: This PHP source file defines the 'StudioModuleFactory' class, which is responsible for managing instances of 'StudioModule' objects, including loading specific subclass modules from the filesystem. It includes methods for retrieving studios modules for given module names, with logic to load from custom or core directories.

classes.name: StudioModuleFactory
classes.description: Factory class that manages the creation and caching of StudioModule instances for different modules, loading custom or default studio modules as required.

methods.name: getStudioModule
methods.description: Returns an instance of a StudioModule or its subclass for the specified module, loading from custom or core directories if not already cached.
